svg.title: Pulsus Dash — NOC wall as a 3D estate world (INC-2041)
svg.desc: 4K NOC wall in Wall density (x1.6 type at DPR 2), readable from 5 m. Most of the wall is a calm, near-monochrome 3D landscape of cloud regions and data centres: plateaus carry cluster cities whose building footprint is capacity and height is load, joined by curved traffic arcs, slowly auto-orbiting (motion hint on the ground). One incident is impossible to miss: the payments district of prod-eu-1 in eu-west-1 glows Failing, with a tall ⊕ light beacon for the probable origin psp-api and a ripple ring; checkout and other victims are ringed and dashed. Side rail: the INC-2041 card with the salience ladder (glow, pulse, focus, takeover), an event ticker and three static-X live charts. HUD: compass, L0–L5 ladder, minimap, view switcher and mode chip.

g.text: Shift+A acknowledges · wall returns to calm
Shift+A returns the wall to calm
